cases.prompt: In Mark, what did Bartimaeus throw aside before getting up to meet Jesus?
claims: Bartimaeus threw aside his cloak and came to Jesus.
The blind beggar had been sitting beside the road.

cases.prompt: In Acts, what were Paul and Silas doing at midnight while the other prisoners listened?
claims: Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns at midnight.
The prison doors opened after an earthquake.

cases.prompt: In Exodus, the ark was covered in gold; which wood was underneath?
claims: The ark was made of acacia wood and overlaid with gold.
Its carrying poles were also acacia wood covered in gold.
